feeds.title: The Boston Day Book
feeds.description: The Boston Day Book is a Boston-based blog written by sisters Natalie Kurtzman and Laura Chassaigne. We write about art, style, food, travel, and city living with kids.

feeds.title: City Living (Boston)
feeds.description: City Living (Boston) is all about what to do in and around Boston, recipes to make, and restaurants to visit. I always include some food for thought and a little recap of our adventures here in New England or somewhere across the world.

feeds.title: Elisabeth McKnight
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Elisabeth, a Boston lifestyle blogger. This blog lives at the intersection of style and function where I share the joys (and struggles) of modern motherhood and life as a new mom.

feeds.title: Boston Chic Party
feeds.description: I'm Jenna - a Boston girl with a serious sweet tooth, an online shopping addiction, and a love for entertaining! This is my little corner of the internet where I celebrate everyday life by sharing some of my favorite things, including (but never limited to!) fashion, entertaining, yummy recipes, and anything Boston.

feeds.title: Bayberry and Main
feeds.description: Sharing everyday journeys of fashion, decor, travel, food, and wellness. Bayberry and Main is a fashion and lifestyle blog that wants you to feel like you are hanging out with your girlfriends getting advice.

feeds.title: The Abroad Blog
feeds.description: A travel blog by a college student who refuses to quit her daydream of seeing the world. Welcome to The Abroad Blog. Thanks for stopping by! My name is Nicole. I'm a 23-year-old from Boston, the voice behind this blog, and the girl who can't stop talking about her time abroad.

feeds.title: Feathers and Stripes
feeds.description: Feathers and Stripes is a lifestyle blog featuring style, travel, and motherhood from Boston and beyond.

feeds.title: The Roving Fox
feeds.description: The Roving Fox is a travel, lifestyle, and food & wine blog dedicated to the good life. Based in Boston, travels everywhere. Hey there, I am Stephanie, aka The Roving Fox I started this blog to share travel tips with friends, and eventually started incorporating more info about my hip labrum surgery, beauty products I love, and restaurant reviews.

feeds.title: Brenda After Sixty Blog
feeds.description: Recent Posts Neighborhood Spotlight Information, resources and local recommendations from neighborhoods in and around Boston. Brenda after Sixty is a source for information and ideas about health, beauty, education, technology, the arts and more, for women aged 60 in the greater Boston area and beyond.

feeds.title: Sacha Eats
feeds.description: Sacha Eats is a Boston food and lifestyle blog written by a life-long local which focuses on Boston's hottest restaurants, things to do, neighborhood guides, restaurant reviews, hidden gems and more.

feeds.title: Kate the (Almost) Great
feeds.description: Kate the (Almost) Great is a lifestyle blog focusing on writing, health, and my millennial life. I am a former high school English teacher who lives with inflammatory arthritis and who has been in pain for over 14 years.

feeds.title: The A-Lyst » Travel
feeds.description: A Boston-based lifestyle blog curating the very best of style, beauty, food, and travel. My love affair with Boston began when I was just a little girl, and for the past 17 years, I've been lucky enough to call this city home. In my opinion, you know you are living in the right place .

feeds.title: DomestiKatedLife
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kate, and I live in a charming coastal town just outside of Boston with my husband and daughter. I have been blogging for over a decade, chronicling my personal adventures in entertaining, home cooking, DIY projects, and motherhood.

feeds.title: B Loved Boston
feeds.description: A Southern girl living in Boston with a passion for fashion, beauty, and life!! I created B~Loved Boston as a creative outlet to share my inspirations and finds! I'm Biana and have lived in Boston since packing everything up and moving after I graduated from the University of Florida

feeds.title: Pumps & Iron
feeds.description: A healthy lifestyle blog sharing workouts, nutritious recipes, fashion ideas and everything in between.

feeds.title: Blonde Meets City Blog
feeds.description: I'm Maria, the 20-something-year-old girl behind Blonde Meets Boston.
